claims.claim: The research shows no significant difference in weight loss between intermittent fasting and daily calorie restriction in most cases — with a notable recent exception.
When total calories are matched between the two approaches, intermittent fasting produces nearly identical weight loss to continuous daily calorie restriction.
A major 2026 Cochrane review examined 22 randomized controlled trials with nearly 2,000 participants.
